s2_00: Top left of a menu picture: a deep indigo-violet blueprint sheet with fine pale lilac line work, a speckled worn paper texture with a fine square grid of pale lilac lines filling the area; at the top there is a thin table row with a small cell in the middle holding the text 'Form AC-4523' in thin pale white-lilac hand-lettered type and a row of small empty square cells under it. The grid cells are all empty, with no numbers or letters. At the right edge is the left edge of a cream paper sheet with a dark border. At the bottom of the tile the grid continues. Dark brown wooden table at the very top edge. No other lettering anywhere: no extra words, no numbers, no signature, no stamps, no new symbols.
s2_01: Top right of a menu picture: the right end of a deep indigo-violet blueprint sheet with fine pale lilac line work, a speckled worn paper texture with a fine square grid at the left, a thin row at the top with a small cell holding the text 'Form AC-4523' in thin pale white-lilac hand-lettered type (F-o-r-m, A-C, hyphen, four five two three) near the left edge of the tile, and, on the right, a large cream-beige paper sheet with a dark border lying on the blueprint. A strip of beige tape with a silver paperclip is stuck at the top right corner of the sheet. The top of the sheet has a flat tan blank bar with a dark outline and a thin dark line under it. Below that, the sheet carries a large pale grey-beige faded round seal with a skull above two crossed bones, soft and washed out, with no lettering around it. The paper is smooth and clean with no creases and no scratches. No other lettering anywhere: no extra words, no numbers, no signature, no stamps, no new symbols.
s2_10: Bottom left of a menu picture: a deep indigo-violet blueprint sheet with fine pale lilac line work, a speckled worn paper texture with a fine square grid in the upper part and, below it, a title block made of thin pale lilac lines: four large empty boxes in two columns, and in each of the lower two boxes one long thin white rectangular outline field; all fields and boxes are completely empty. Below the blueprint border, near the bottom, there is one short handwritten line in thin pale lilac pencil, exactly: 'SCALE 1"=10'0"'. Under it a black bar and dark brown wooden table at the very bottom. The right edge shows the left edge of a cream paper sheet. No other lettering anywhere: no extra words, no numbers, no signature, no stamps, no new symbols.
